# Fit

```{r}
#| label: fits
#| results: false
fits <- get_fits()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-fixef
#| tbl-cap: "Population-level coefficients (posterior mean, SD, 90% credible interval)."
bind_rows(lapply(specs$model, function(m) {
  fixef(fits[[m]], probs = c(0.05, 0.95)) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("parameter") |>
    mutate(model = m, .before = 1)
})) |>
  kable(digits = 2)
```
